description: Character exploration sheet, four DIFFERENT guild shield-bearers in reading order, 2 by 2 separated full-body cels. Each is one attractive, memorable, hand-pixelled mobile RPG enemy. Observe distinct pose block-ins in the layout, invent the final rendering. Unhelmeted human, expressive large head, compact build, looking screen-left three-quarter, adventuring guild dress, a single imposing shield from shoulder to shin gripped close in front. Show face, boots, clothing and a small mace in secondary hand. A / muscular sun-browned caravan captain with thick swept-back dark hair, cropped beard, rolled ivory sleeve, short indigo tabard. Charging forward leading with a blue round shield in bronze rings; big readable raised bronze boss. B / a lean, white-templed old sergeant with a hooked nose and heavy eyebrows, one hand resting low on his mace, standing easy behind a towering oxblood hide pavise; narrow brass spine and swallowtail blue mantle. C / a red-braided stocky woman, low, weight over one bent leg, back heel dug in, quilted blue Guild jack. Large cream and navy quartered tear-shaped shield tipped up and out at an angle. D / a young powerful dark-skinned man with a crown of short curls, mustard gambeson, dark indigo baldric; shoulders turned into a fluted, swept steel shield, mace up behind opposite shoulder. Craft the silhouettes, sparing highlights, distinct eyes, strong hands and believable shield grip. Matching chunky anatomy and 3/4 faces with Guild Swordsman. Inspired and lived-in, rich cloth over small patches of mail. Rattlebones cluster economy and fine warm-black outline, top-left light, flat color shapes. Transparent margin all sides. No stage, text, labels, grids, helmets, scenic elements, logos, floating shields, skulls or crowns.
